card.name: Words just before a proper name
card.fires_on: Small words, titles or commas that sit right before a named person, river or place in encyclopedia-style or news text, such as "include the" before Bull Run River.

modes.label: Linking word before a place name
modes.description: A "the" or comma in a list of rivers or places, just before the next name.

modes.label: Title or role before a person's name
modes.description: A title or job word such as Cardinal, architect or Rapper that comes right before a full name.
modes.example: +John<< Cardinal>> Farley, Archbishop of New York.

modes.label: Word before a noun in a set phrase
modes.description: A word inside a fixed phrase where a specific noun follows, such as seal of safety.
modes.example: No utilizar si el sello de<< seguridad>> del spray esta roto.
